source: MaleCNS v1.0 body annotations: somaLocation, restricted to Stonkfly graph.npz ids

coordinate_system.stored: raw source somaLocation [x,y,z]; no axis swaps, jitter, synthesis, or unit conversion
coordinate_system.units: source coordinate units; physical voxel size not established by supplied manifest

display_transform.description: Uniform affine normalization; longest full-data axis spans [-1,1], aspect ratio preserved.

sampling.method: 12x12x12 spatial strata over all eligible somata; lexicographic cell round-robin; SHA-256(soma-v1:<id>) order within cell
sampling.scope: All graph neurons with finite somaLocation, including brain and ventral nerve cord; spatially stratified, not a population-density estimate.

provenance.id_join: annotations.bodyId equals graph.npz ids, exact integer identity

attribution.work: MaleCNS v1.0 connectome and body annotations
attribution.creator: MaleCNS / FlyEM data contributors
attribution.changes: Restricted to model graph IDs, omitted absent/nonfinite somata, deterministic spatial subsampling; raw soma coordinates preserved.
